description: Run and follow your TeamCity builds: trigger builds with a branch and parameters, wait for them, read their status, log, problems, tests and artifacts, cancel, pin, tag and comment on them, pause configurations, manage agents, and start a workflow when a build fails, finishes or starts, or an agent disconnects.

teamcity_agent_disconnected_trigger.description: Runs when an authorized build agent disconnects from TeamCity, such as when its machine goes down. It runs again the next time, once the agent is back.

parameters.description: Only agents in this pool, such as Default. Leave blank for every pool.
parameters.name: pool

teamcity_build_failed_trigger.description: Runs when a TeamCity build fails, of every configuration, one or a project's, on any branch or one, with TeamCity's summary of why. Cancelled builds and builds that failed before the workflow was turned on don't start it.

parameters.description: Only builds of this project's configurations, its subprojects' included, as its ID. Leave blank for every project.
parameters.name: project

parameters.description: Only builds of this build configuration, as its ID. Leave blank for every one.
parameters.name: build_configuration

parameters.description: Only builds of this branch, such as main. Leave blank for every branch.
parameters.name: branch

teamcity_build_finished_trigger.description: Runs when a TeamCity build finishes, successful or failed, or only with the status you choose. Cancelled builds don't start it.

parameters.description: Only builds of this project's configurations, its subprojects' included, as its ID. Leave blank for every project.
parameters.name: project

parameters.description: Only builds of this build configuration, as its ID. Leave blank for every one.
parameters.name: build_configuration

parameters.description: Only builds of this branch, such as main. Leave blank for every branch.
parameters.name: branch

parameters.description: success for only successful builds, failure for only failed ones. Leave blank for any.
parameters.name: status

teamcity_build_started_trigger.description: Runs when a TeamCity build starts on an agent, of every configuration, one or a project's, on any branch or one.

parameters.description: Only builds of this project's configurations, its subprojects' included, as its ID. Leave blank for every project.
parameters.name: project

parameters.description: Only builds of this build configuration, as its ID. Leave blank for every one.
parameters.name: build_configuration

parameters.description: Only builds of this branch, such as main. Leave blank for every branch.
